issues.display_title: Issue #182: Editor: dark mode toggle + app-wide theme
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Summary

Add a working, persistent dark mode with a manual toggle in the editor topbar. Theme applies app-wide, persists across reloads, defaults to OS preference.

The .dark token block and @custom-variant dark already exist in globals.css; editor --editor-* vars alias shadcn tokens that flip automatically. Only missing piece: a mechanism to put .dark on <html>.

Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-03-editor-dark-mode-design.md
Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-03-editor-dark-mode.md

Tasks

  • Wire next-themes — add dep, wrap Providers with <ThemeProvider attribute="class" defaultTheme="system" enableSystem>, add suppressHydrationWarning to <html> in layout.tsx.
  • Toggle button — Sun/Moon Button in EditorTopbar.tsx calling useTheme().setTheme, with mounted guard.
  • Fix 3 invisible-in-dark spots — text-white on --editor-rich-black (= --foreground, flips near-white in dark):
    • InformationModal.tsx:218 → bg-foreground text-background
    • EditorTopbar.tsx:277 → hover:opacity-90
    • MapTransformControl.tsx:216 → hover:opacity-90

Acceptance criteria

  • Toggle in editor topbar flips whole app light/dark.
  • Theme persists across reload; first load follows OS preference.
  • No flash-of-wrong-theme on load.
  • No white-on-white / invisible text in any editor modal in dark mode.
  • npx tsc --noEmit and npx eslint . green.
  • --editor-canvas-white (drawing surface) stays white in both themes.

Out of scope

  • App-wide toggle UI (only editor gets the button).
  • Dark-mode-specific redesign of components.

RESULT

demo.by.developer.floormap.darkmode.mp4

Implemented app-wide dark mode on branch feature/182-editor-dark-mode (6 commits).

  • next-themes mechanism (938b8be): providers.tsx ThemeProvider (attribute="class" defaultTheme="system" enableSystem); layout.tsx suppressHydrationWarning. Topbar Sun/Moon toggle (id="btn-theme-toggle") — icons via CSS dark: variant instead of the planned mount-guard (lint-clean, no hydration mismatch). Three planned contrast fixes applied.
  • Chrome surface flip (0e7c6cf): root cause beyond ticket — --editor-canvas-white (#fff, never flipped) backed ALL editor chrome, not just the drawing surface, so the editor stayed white in dark. It now flips to var(--card) in .dark; paired rich-black/canvas-white spots stay contrasting since both flip.
  • Dashboard switch (9bdd125): Dark mode toggle switch row in the profile dropdown (scope extension per request); minimal inline switch, no new dep.
  • Canvas + 3D follow theme (96b37aa3): engine resolves tokens once at init and its existing refreshTheme() was never called; also a resolvedTheme effect fires before the root provider applies .dark. Fixed with a MutationObserver on <html> class. Drawing panels now use --background; scene3d uses its built-in dark palette.
  • Backdrop invert (85e4afb): white-paper floorplan image turned mid-gray on dark canvas and drowned strokes — invert(1) filter on the backdrop draw when dark.
  • Chart ramp (8c20de4): .dark --chart-* was a copy of the light grays (tuned for white paper) — lifted to 0.87–0.5 so room labels/dots, doors, windows, icons stay legible.

Verification: npx tsc --noEmit + npx eslint clean; verified in-browser (login flow, Hotel project): toggle flips whole app both directions, persists across reload, editor chrome/modals/canvas/3D all follow, no invisible text found.
